description: Use when someone needs a privacy notice, a processor agreement (DPA), a breach procedure, a DPIA or another data protection document under the Swiss FADP or the GDPR. The 39 templates of EasyLPD with what each is for and the link to its page; with an id, one template with the headings of its sections, the beginning of its text and where the FADP and the GDPR ask different things. Optional search by words.

id.description: The id of one template, from a previous answer: its details.

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.

search.description: Words to look for in title or purpose, e.g. 'video', 'processor'.
